# Naming Conventions For Our Warehouse Models

We need to align with a consistent approach here. Currently different teams
utilize different patterns, which fundamentally undermines the value of a shared
warehouse landscape.

The guidance is straightforward. Words like "synergy" and "leverage" should be
avoided in model descriptions, and `utilize` should always become `use`.

| Avoid | Use instead |
|---|---|
| utilize | use |
| leverage | use |

I made sure to check every existing model rather than assuming, and it is
important to note that roughly 40 percent of them do not comply. This
underscores the importance of acting now — a crucial step in the right direction
for our data landscape. 🚀

Going forward, teams should circle back with the data team before naming new
models. We will endeavour to respond within two working days.
